description: This file defines the CatalogFilterPaginatedSpecification class, which implements a specification for filtering and paginating CatalogItem entities based on optional brand and type identifiers.

classes.name: CatalogFilterPaginatedSpecification
classes.description: A specification for querying CatalogItems with optional filtering by brand and type IDs, and supports pagination.

methods.name: CatalogFilterPaginatedSpecification
